The '''Oasis Republic Post''' was a security checkpoint in the [[Ancient Stasis Zone]] in [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The checkpoint remained active and manned by Rakata warden [[Droid/Legends|droids]] thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the collapse of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], and the droids allowed [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces to visit the outpost without attacking.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Oasis Republic Post is the northern Republic base in the Tomb on the planet Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
